philosophy: Fun first, fair second, monetization third
rules: Arena must remain fair without spending
Premium track focuses on cosmetics and convenience
Avoid grind walls and purchase-only power
sourceCultureCosmeticRule: Cosmetics must be faction-faithful source-culture variants: palettes, relic silhouettes, banners, aura trims, armor finishes, and battlefield props may vary, but cannot turn into generic RPG gear, cosplay, sci-fi, or mismatched myth symbols.
